St. Petersburg’s Nevsky District Court has sentenced animator Oleg Kuvayev, creator of the animated series “Masyanya,” in absentia to four years and one month in a penal colony, Mediazona reported.

Actual Article Body:
St. Petersburg’s Nevsky District Court has sentenced animator Oleg Kuvayev, creator of the animated series “Masyanya,” in absentia to four years and one month in a penal colony, Mediazona reported.

Kuvayev was charged with failing to meet his obligations as a “foreign agent” (Article 330.1 of Russia’s Criminal Code) and calling for activities directed against state security (Article 280.4).

Prosecutors had requested a prison sentence of five years and 11 months.

News of a criminal investigation into Kuvayev for calling for activities directed against state security emerged in October 2023. The investigation stemmed from an episode of “Masyanya” in which the main character urges Russian soldiers to surrender.
